translated_title: EZLN Says the Three Levels of Government Are Trying to Prevent It From Meeting With Searching Mothers in Mexico City
original_title: EZLN señala que los tres órdenes de gobierno intentan impedir que se reúna con madres buscadoras en CDMX
author: Elio Henríquez
meta_description: The Zapatistas plan to send 1,530 members to embrace families of the disappeared in December and denounce harassment of their communities in Chiapas.
